title: IF ( condition, TRUE (), 0 ) returns TRUE or 0, not a converted value
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( T, "x", IF ( T[n] > 1, TRUE (), 0 ) )

source.quote: the formula IF(<condition>, TRUE(), 0) returns TRUE or 0
source.supports: a boolean branch and a numeric branch are not converted to one type

derivation: n = 1 gets the integer 0; n = 2 and 3 get TRUE. A boolean is not a numeric type, so the two branches keep their types and the column is a variant.
